name: context-canvas-codex
description: Continuable task maps plus policy-sanitized historical tool snapshots for Codex App and CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Continue task maps and archive historical tool snapshots.
interface.longDescription: Keeps session provenance separate from a continuable semantic task lineage and a local PostToolUse snapshot store. Task maps reopen without destructive mismatch errors, explicit continuation preserves a hash-bound predecessor, and recent canvases plus filtered snapshot history remain discoverable. Snapshots use explicit textual-redaction and opaque-media policies, content addressing, deduplication, bounded retention, and explicit export.
defaultPrompt: Create or restore the task map for this work, including active blockers after compaction.
List my recent task canvases and continue the relevant lineage here.
Search this task map or historical tool snapshots and prepare a closeout or policy-sanitized export.
